reviews.text: First time having our small yorkie boarded and he did well with them. Hes not used to being around other dogs but they still gave him one on one and attempted to try with the others so I appreciate that effort. Pepe came back smelling fresh after his bath. Great updates through the stay. Will have him stay here again when needed.

We have brought our dog here for years and have always had very nice interactions with the staff.   Our dog, although he’s not allowed to play with other dogs because of his temperament, still wags his tail when we pull into the parking lot and seems like he was well cared for while we were gone.  One of the stand out people is James, one of their groomers. He is so kind and patient with the dogs and he does an impeccable job every time and you don’t have to board your dog here in order to book him.

Willy had an amazing time at doggy daycare and came home looking dapper after his grooming session! He had a great day and passed out immediately on the car ride home. ❤️ It’s clear the staff truly care about the dogs in their care. They’re also fantastic communicators and were quick to answer any questions I had. I left him feeling confident and relaxed. It was also great watching him on the doggy cam! Keep up the great work team!

I take my dog here every time I go out of town, and I’ve had a wonderful experience each time. The staff is so friendly and welcoming, and they’re professionally trained to handle dogs of all breeds and sizes. I have a 65 lb American staffy, and I’m super careful about who I let take care of him due to his breed and rowdy personality. I can rest easy knowing Paw Commons has his best interest at heart, and he always comes home so happy and loved. Could not recommend this place enough!

This review is solely for the Group Obedience Class with Emma does not reflect my experience with Paw Commons as a whole.

Unfortunately, I would not recommend the Group Obedience Class with Emma. I enrolled because my private trainer recommended a group setting to help desensitize my rescue, around other dogs. From the first class, I felt that she was singled out and treated more like a problem to manage than a dog learning in a beginner obedience environment. We were repeatedly separated from the rest of the class, which left me feeling isolated rather than supported.

What ultimately improved our experience was not the class itself, but the involvement of other trainers. The manager, Zoe, spent one-on-one time working with us, provided constructive guidance, and even coordinated with my private trainer to help support my dog’s progress. Their encouragement and expertise made a noticeable difference.

To be clear, my dog made great progress over the six weeks, and I am grateful for the additional support we received. However, throughout most of the course I did not feel much support, compassion, or investment from Emma regarding my dog’s development which is why I could never recommend this class to anyone who is actually looking for support to train their pet.

The staff at Paw Commons is wonderful.  We had Cannoli in there at least a couple times a month, sometimes for a week.  We left her with Paw Commons for a month, they were so good at communicating.  She had some digestive problems and the staff contacted me to ask if they should take her to the Veterinarian.  I said yes and they took her and got her on a prescription diet.

Cannoli was there yesterday and today, she ended up getting stung be a bee.  They were quick to call me and ask if they should give her Benadryl, I said yes.  They kept a close eye on her to make sure she wasn't allergic to the Bee Sting.  I recommend this facility to any pup parents out there.

Rex struggled with reactivity against other dogs and walking on a leash without pulling me to the ground.  With proper commands and training Rex now walks by my side and doesn't lunge at other dogs on walks. If you need a skilled, caring professional who truly listens to your goals, look no further than Illya at Paw Commons in Kearny Mesa 👌 Thank you,  Illya!

I brought my pup in for an evaluation today. I was very nervous because it was my first experience with daycare. The stuff was very understanding about it. They gave me a little tour, showed me where the dogs play on camera, and answered all of my questions. My pup seemed to enjoy his time there since he didn't want to get into the car when I picked him up😂 I also appreciate the staff taking goofy pictures of him during his time there. Overall good experience, will definitely bring him over whenever I need to leave him alone. Thank you, my baby had a blast today!

I have been taking my dog, Marty, to Paw Commons for a couple of years and it has always been a great experience. He's has stayed at the Bay Park and Kearney Mesa locations. I have used their boarding, daycare, and grooming services and everything is always done in a friendly and professional manner. I think their prices are fair for the area and services they provide. Everyone takes great care of Marty, and I really appreciate it! I am very comfortable leaving my dog in their care.

Today was Henry’s 1st day at day camp. ( the pug) he LOVED IT! It freed me up to do a dental appt and deep clean the carpets while he was having the time of his life!! I highly recommend Paw Common’s. The staff were wonderful

There are not enough positive things to say about Paw Commons in Kearny Mesa. Between the pool and all of her friends, our pup always has the time of her life! Most importantly, the staff treat our dog with the love and care as if she is one of their own. Whether it is Elizabeth or Cat or Taylor on the desk (or any of the other staff), we always feel 110% confident that they will take the best care of her no matter what.

Furthermore, to have had the opportunity to work with Mia as our trainer over the past several months has been the best investment we have made. She is deeply knowledgeable, very good at explaining the concepts underlying the techniques, and most importantly, makes training a truly fun experience (for both humans and dogs)!

Thanks to everyone for everything… we look forward to seeing you again very soon!
The girls are always so nice and professional when I take my dog Shade in whether it’s for boarding or daycare. Additionally the groomer Savannah does an amazing job at grooming my pup.

Ollie absolutely loves coming to Paw Commons. He comes once a week. He plays nonstop for six hours and comes home and just collapses on the couch.haha
We always know he’s in great hands.

We picked up our dogs, Duke (German shepherd) and Chloe (lab) today. We portioned out exactly enough food for them for our 6 day trip. When we picked them up, 7 bags of food were returned to us. Not sure which one of them wasn't fed for 3.5 days, but that was obviously unacceptable. Duke is limping and has pain in his hips. He's 4 years old and hasn't ever previously had hip pain. Neither one of our dogs is eating. They both refused dinner tonight. Our lab has NEVER refused a meal in the 9 years that I've had her. Both of them are acting off and isolating. Also, we paid $80 for a *mandatory* bath "since they were picked up after 1pm". They both smell like feces. We took them to a DIY dog wash this morning and the water turned brown. I guess they didn’t think that we’d notice that they didn’t wash our dogs? (Update - called and spoke to the manager. They didn’t do the bath and didn’t charge us for it like they were supposed to. She said that Duke only ate 1 full meal then they’d put the old food back down every meal. They waited until the night before we picked him up to ask us if they could incentivize him to eat. That was a mistake on their part. They should’ve reached out after 2 skipped meals. Not after TEN skipped meals.)

My Golden Retriever, Rigby, is very old, overweight, plagued with arthritis, and unable to stand for more than a few minutes. Numerous other places turned us away when he needed grooming, (particularly for sanitary reasons) because he's such a big job. Paw Commons was the place that was compassionate enough to take him on. Today Anna did a GREAT job for the second time, cutting him short but not shaving him. Im so grateful to have found this place! The people there are friendly, kind, and professional. Thanks so much, you all!!

Paw Commons is the only place we trust with our dog! We go there for training, daycare, and boarding. Specifically, training with Mia has been INCREDIBLE. She is so knowledgeable and has taught us so much. We’ve seen so much improvement since working with her and we’re so grateful for her!

I first started using Paw Pet Commons located in Kearny Mesa about a week and a half ago. I was a little apprehensive at first because I had never had my dog away from my sight for a minute as she's gets extremely stressed out when I'm out of her sight. Separation anxiety is common with my breed of dog and I have to take partial blame for spoiling her too much. I was delighted to see she has done overwhelming well with the other dog's and gets so excited as soon as we turn down the street that they're located on. She and myself think the staff does excellent job with the dog's and I can tell they take pride in what they do which in turn makes me feel comfortable throughout the day. I couldn't be happier with the service they provide. I can't say enough positive things about every employee I interacted with at Kearny Mesa. I would recommend this place to anyone who needs care for their dog. My dog couldn't say enough thanks if she could talk as well.

We paid for the platinum package but received what I assume would be their regular (bottom of the barrel) services. We dropped our dog off on a Tuesday evening and they were going to do an introductory session and see how he mixed with the other dogs. That didn’t happen until Friday afternoon and that was because I called them for an update. During the period of Tuesday to Friday they kept him by himself. He was picked up on Sunday. From Tuesday to Sunday we only had one “report card” although it was supposed to be daily updates. We paid a large amount of money for top notch service and did not get it. We were worried that entire time and couldn’t even enjoy our time away. VERY disappointed!

I’ve been very happy, but more importantly my pug Dash has been very happy, with his playcare (daycare) at PawCommons in Kearny Mesa. He’s always excited to arrive, then nicely tired when he leaves.  The staff is very friendly and kind to Dash and always seem genuinely happy to see him. Thank you for taking such great care of my little boy. We both appreciate you guys a ton!

Paw Commons staff are fantastic. My house hippo  (English Staffy) is always excited to play with other pups every week! The live webcams are great as I can see him go between both yards and the staff giving him attention as he loves people.

Super easy to use to book daycare on their website or through text.
